name: raycast-keymap
title: KeyMap
description: Search and execute CLI tools and reference books
author: yeshouyou

preferences.name: toolsDir
preferences.title: Tools Directory
preferences.description: Absolute path(s) to tool JSONs. ⚠️ Use comma (,) to separate multiple paths.

preferences.name: booksDir
preferences.title: Books Directory
preferences.description: Absolute path(s) to book JSONs. ⚠️ Use comma (,) to separate multiple paths.

preferences.name: aiTaskTimeoutSeconds
preferences.title: AI Task Timeout (Seconds)
preferences.description: How long before an active AI task is considered timed out and removed.

preferences.name: remoteToolsUrls
preferences.title: Remote Tools URLs
preferences.description: Comma-separated URLs to remote JSON tool libraries (e.g., https://raw.github.../team.json)

preferences.name: contextAppMappings
preferences.title: Context App Mappings
preferences.description: JSON mapping of App Name to tags (e.g., {"code": ["node", "git"], "iterm2": ["docker"]})

preferences.name: favoriteDirs
preferences.title: Favorite Directories
preferences.description: Comma-separated paths to show in the file browser dropdown.

preferences.name: defaultShell
preferences.title: Default Shell (Silent Mode)
preferences.description: Absolute path to the shell used for silent execution. Leave empty to use system default.

preferences.name: globalEnvVars
preferences.title: Global Environment Variables
preferences.description: JSON string of global variables to replace {{env.VAR_NAME}} in commands.

preferences.name: scriptsDir
preferences.title: Scripts Directory
preferences.description: Absolute path(s) to custom dynamic scripts. ⚠️ Use comma (,) to separate multiple paths.

preferences.name: aiBaseUrl
preferences.title: AI Base URL
preferences.description: OpenAI-compatible API Base URL (e.g., http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama)

preferences.name: aiApiKey
preferences.title: AI API Key
preferences.description: API Key for the AI service (leave empty for local Ollama)

preferences.name: fallbackAiBaseUrl
preferences.title: Fallback AI Base URL
preferences.description: Base URL for fallback AI (used after 2 failures)

preferences.name: fallbackAiApiKey
preferences.title: Fallback AI API Key
preferences.description: API Key for the fallback AI service

preferences.name: aiHistoryRetentionDays
preferences.title: AI History Retention (Days)
preferences.description: Number of days to keep AI query history

preferences.name: aiHistoryDisplayCount
preferences.title: AI History Display Count
preferences.description: Number of AI history items to show on the main screen
